|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain_id|path|string|true|Paddle ID of the checkout domain entity to work with.|
|body|body|[CheckoutDomainVerifyPaymentMethod](#schemacheckoutdomainverifypaymentmethod)|true|none|
|» payment_method|body|[CheckoutDomainPaymentMethod](#schemacheckoutdomainpaymentmethod)|true|Payment method to verify. Currently only apple_pay is supported.|

<h1 id="paddle-api-businesses">Businesses</h1>

Business entities hold information about customer businesses. They're sub-entities of customers.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/businesses">Business entity overview</a>

## List businesses for a customer

<a id="opIdlist-businesses"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/customers/ctm_01grnn4zta5a1mf02jjze7y2ys/businesses \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{customer_id}/businesses`

Returns a paginated list of businesses for a customer. Use the query parameters to page through results.

By default, Paddle returns businesses that are `active`. Use the `status` query parameter to return businesses that are archived.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/businesses/list-businesses">List businesses for a customer</a>

<h3 id="list-businesses-for-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|[string]|false|Return only the IDs specified. Use a comma-separated list to get multiple entities.|
|after|query|string|false|Return entities after the specified Paddle ID when working with paginated endpoints. Used in the `meta.pagination.next` URL in responses for list operations.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Set how many entities are returned per page. Paddle returns the maximum number of results if a number greater than the maximum is requested. Check `meta.pagination.per_page` in the response to see how many were returned.<br><br>Default: `50`; Maximum: `200`.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Order returned entities by the specified field and direction (`[ASC]` or `[DESC]`). For example, `?order_by=id[ASC]`.<br><br>Valid fields for ordering: `id`.|
|status|query|[[StatusQuery](#schemastatusquery)]|false|Return entities that match the specified status. Use a comma-separated list to specify multiple status values.|
|search|query|string|false|Return entities that match a search query. Searches all fields, including contacts, except `status`, `created_at`, and `updated_at`.|
|customer_id|path|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|Paddle ID of the customer entity to work with.|
|Skip-Count|header|string|false|Set to `true` to skip the count query on list operations. When set, `meta.pagination.estimated_total` returns `-1` instead of an exact count.|

## Update a business for a customer

<a id="opIdupdate-business"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/customers/ctm_01grnn4zta5a1mf02jjze7y2ys/businesses/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "contacts": [
      {
        "name": "Parker Jones",
        "email": "parker@example.com"
      },
      {
        "name": "Jo Riley",
        "email": "jo@example.com"
      },
      {
        "name": "Jesse Garcia",
        "email": "jo@example.com"
      }
    ],
    "custom_data": {
      "customer_reference_id": "eb9b8d9b-7dd6-48e6-8c39-8557bba5eaa9"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /customers/{customer_id}/businesses/{business_id}`

Updates a business for a customer using its ID and related customer ID.

If successful, your response includes a copy of the updated business entity.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/businesses/update-business">Update a business for a customer</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "contacts": [
    {
      "name": "Parker Jones",
      "email": "parker@example.com"
    },
    {
      "name": "Jo Riley",
      "email": "jo@example.com"
    },
    {
      "name": "Jesse Garcia",
      "email": "jo@example.com"
    }
  ],
  "custom_data": {
    "customer_reference_id": "eb9b8d9b-7dd6-48e6-8c39-8557bba5eaa9"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-business-for-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|business_id|path|string|true|Paddle ID of the business entity to work with.|
|customer_id|path|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|Paddle ID of the customer entity to work with.|
|body|body|[BusinessUpdate](#schemabusinessupdate)|true|none|
|» name|body|object|false|Name of this business.|
|» company_number|body|string \| null|false|Company number for this business.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» tax_identifier|body|string \| null|false|Tax or VAT Number for this business.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» status|body|[Status](#schemastatus)|false|Whether this entity can be used in Paddle.|
|» contacts|body|[[ContactsCreate](#schemacontactscreate)] \| null|false|List of contacts related to this business, typically used for sending invoices.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[[ContactsCreate](#schemacontactscreate)]|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» custom_data|body|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata)|false|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|active|
|» status|archived|

<h1 id="paddle-api-api-root">API root</h1>

The API root describes the Paddle API and the caller making the request, including the account and permissions for the credentials used.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/api-root">API root overview</a>

## Get API root

<a id="opIdget-api-root"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/ \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /`

Returns information about the Paddle API and the caller making the request, including their account and permissions.

Authentication is optional. A request with no credentials still succeeds, with `caller.auth_type` and `caller.account` set to `null` and an empty `caller.permissions`. A request with an API key that isn't valid returns a `403` error, like any other operation. To check that an API key works, make sure `caller.account` isn't `null`.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/api-root/get-api-root">Get API root</a>

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "api": {
      "name": "Paddle API",
      "version": "1",
      "environment": "production",
      "documentation_url": "https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/overview"
    },
    "caller": {
      "auth_type": null,
      "account": null,
      "permissions": []
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "3f1e6c8a-2b4d-4a90-8c7e-1d2f3a4b5c6d"
  }
}
```

<h1 id="paddle-api-adjustments">Adjustments</h1>

Adjustment entities describe post-billing adjustments to billed or completed transactions.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/adjustments">Adjustments entity overview</a>

## List adjustments

<a id="opIdlist-adjustments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/adjustments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /adjustments`

Returns a paginated list of adjustments. Use the query parameters to page through results.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/adjustments/list-adjustments">List adjustments</a>

<h3 id="list-adjustments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|[string]|false|Return only the IDs specified. Use a comma-separated list to get multiple entities.|
|after|query|string|false|Return entities after the specified Paddle ID when working with paginated endpoints. Used in the `meta.pagination.next` URL in responses for list operations.|
|action|query|[[AdjustmentActionQuery](#schemaadjustmentactionquery)]|false|Return entities for the specified action. Use a comma-separated list to specify multiple action values.|
|customer_id|query|[string]|false|Return entities related to the specified customer. Use a comma-separated list to specify multiple customer IDs.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Order returned entities by the specified field and direction (`[ASC]` or `[DESC]`). For example, `?order_by=id[ASC]`.<br><br>Valid fields for ordering: `id`.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Set how many entities are returned per page. Paddle returns the maximum number of results if a number greater than the maximum is requested. Check `meta.pagination.per_page` in the response to see how many were returned.<br><br>Default: `10`; Maximum: `50`.|
|status|query|[[AdjustmentStatusQuery](#schemaadjustmentstatusquery)]|false|Return entities that match the specified status. Use a comma-separated list to specify multiple status values.|
|subscription_id|query|[string]|false|Return entities related to the specified subscription. Use a comma-separated list to specify multiple subscription IDs.|
|transaction_id|query|[string]|false|Return entities related to the specified transaction. Use a comma-separated list to specify multiple transaction IDs.|
|Skip-Count|header|string|false|Set to `true` to skip the count query on list operations. When set, `meta.pagination.estimated_total` returns `-1` instead of an exact count.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|action|credit|
|action|refund|
|action|chargeback|
|action|chargeback_reverse|
|action|chargeback_warning|
|action|chargeback_warning_reverse|
|action|credit_reverse|
|status|pending_approval|
|status|approved|
|status|rejected|
|status|reversed|

## Create an adjustment

<a id="opIdcreate-adjustment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/adjustments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "refund",
    "items": [
      {
        "item_id": "txnitm_01hvcc94b7qgz60qmrqmbm19zw",
        "type": "partial",
        "amount": "100"
      }
    ],
    "reason": "error",
    "transaction_id": "txn_01hvcc93znj3mpqt1tenkjb04y"
  }'
```

`POST /adjustments`

Creates an adjustment for one or more transaction items.

You can create adjustments to refund or credit all or part of a transaction and its items:

* Refunds return an amount to a customer's original payment method. You can create refund adjustments for transactions that are `completed`.
* Credits reduce the amount that a customer has to pay for a transaction. You can create credit adjustments for manually-collected transactions that are `billed` or `past_due`.

You can create adjustments to refund transactions that are `completed`, or to reduce the amount to due on manually-collected transactions that are `billed` or `past_due`.
Most refunds for live accounts are created with the status of `pending_approval` until reviewed by Paddle, but [some are automatically approved](https://developer.paddle.com/build/transactions/create-transaction-adjustments#background-refunds). For sandbox accounts, Paddle automatically approves refunds every ten minutes.

Adjustments can apply to some or all items on a transaction. You'll need the Paddle ID of the transaction to create a refund or credit for, along with the Paddle ID of any transaction items (`details.line_items[].id`).

If successful, your response includes a copy of the new adjustment entity.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/adjustments/create-adjustment">Create an adjustment</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "refund",
  "items": [
    {
      "item_id": "txnitm_01hvcc94b7qgz60qmrqmbm19zw",
      "type": "partial",
      "amount": "100"
    }
  ],
  "reason": "error",
  "transaction_id": "txn_01hvcc93znj3mpqt1tenkjb04y"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-adjustment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AdjustmentCreate](#schemaadjustmentcreate)|true|none|
|» action|body|[AdjustmentAction](#schemaadjustmentaction)|true|How this adjustment impacts the related transaction.|
|» type|body|object|false|none|
|» tax_mode|body|object|false|none|
|» transaction_id|body|object|true|Paddle ID of the transaction that this adjustment is for, prefixed with `txn_`.<br><br>Automatically-collected transactions must be `completed`; manually-collected transactions must have a status of `billed` or `past_due`<br><br>You can't create an adjustment for a transaction that has a refund that's pending approval.|
|» reason|body|string|true|Why this adjustment was created. Appears in the Paddle dashboard. Retained for recordkeeping purposes.|
|» items|body|[[AdjustmentItemCreate](#schemaadjustmentitemcreate)] \| null|false|List of transaction items to adjust. Required if `type` is not populated or set to `partial`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[[AdjustmentItemCreate](#schemaadjustmentitemcreate)]|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

|» action|credit_reverse|

## Get a PDF credit note for an adjustment

<a id="opIdget-adjustment-credit-note"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/adjustments/string/credit-note \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /adjustments/{adjustment_id}/credit-note`

Returns a link to a credit note PDF for an adjustment.

Credit note PDFs are created for refunds and credits as a record of an adjustment.

The link returned is not a permanent link. It expires after an hour.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/adjustments/get-credit-note-pdf">Get a PDF credit note for an adjustment</a>

<h3 id="get-a-pdf-credit-note-for-an-adjustment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|adjustment_id|path|string|true|Paddle ID of the adjustment entity to work with.|
|disposition|query|[Disposition](#schemadisposition)|false|Determine whether the generated URL should download the PDF as an attachment saved locally, or open it inline in the browser.<br><br>Default: `attachment`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|disposition|attachment|
|disposition|inline|

<h1 id="paddle-api-addresses">Addresses</h1>

Address entities hold billing address information for a customer. They're sub-entities of customers.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/addresses">Address entity overview</a>

## List addresses for a customer

<a id="opIdlist-addresses"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/customers/ctm_01grnn4zta5a1mf02jjze7y2ys/addresses \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{customer_id}/addresses`

Returns a paginated list of addresses for a customer. Use the query parameters to page through results.

By default, Paddle returns addresses that are `active`. Use the `status` query parameter to return addresses that are archived.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/addresses/list-addresses">List addresses for a customer</a>

<h3 id="list-addresses-for-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|[string]|false|Return only the IDs specified. Use a comma-separated list to get multiple entities.|
|after|query|string|false|Return entities after the specified Paddle ID when working with paginated endpoints. Used in the `meta.pagination.next` URL in responses for list operations.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Set how many entities are returned per page. Paddle returns the maximum number of results if a number greater than the maximum is requested. Check `meta.pagination.per_page` in the response to see how many were returned.<br><br>Default: `50`; Maximum: `200`.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Order returned entities by the specified field and direction (`[ASC]` or `[DESC]`). For example, `?order_by=id[ASC]`.<br><br>Valid fields for ordering: `id`.|
|status|query|[[StatusQuery](#schemastatusquery)]|false|Return entities that match the specified status. Use a comma-separated list to specify multiple status values.|
|search|query|string|false|Return entities that match a search query. Searches all fields except `status`, `created_at`, and `updated_at`.|
|customer_id|path|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|Paddle ID of the customer entity to work with.|
|Skip-Count|header|string|false|Set to `true` to skip the count query on list operations. When set, `meta.pagination.estimated_total` returns `-1` instead of an exact count.|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|archived|

## Create an address for a customer

<a id="opIdcreate-address"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/customers/ctm_01grnn4zta5a1mf02jjze7y2ys/addresses \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

    "description": "Head Office",
    "first_line": "4050 Jefferson Plaza, 41st Floor",
    "city": "New York",

    "region": "NY",
    "country_code": "US"
  }'
```

`POST /customers/{customer_id}/addresses`

Creates a new address for a customer.

For tax calculation, fraud prevention, and compliance purposes, you must include a `postal_code` when creating addresses for some countries. For example, ZIP codes in the USA and postcodes in the UK. See: [Supported countries](https://developer.paddle.com/concepts/sell/supported-countries-locales)

If successful, your response includes a copy of the new address entity.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/addresses/create-address">Create an address for a customer</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "Head Office",
  "first_line": "4050 Jefferson Plaza, 41st Floor",
  "city": "New York",
  "postal_code": "10021",
  "region": "NY",
  "country_code": "US"
}
```

## Get an address for a customer

<a id="opIdget-address"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/customers/ctm_01grnn4zta5a1mf02jjze7y2ys/addresses/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{customer_id}/addresses/{address_id}`

Returns an address for a customer using its ID and related customer ID.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/addresses/get-address">Get an address for a customer</a>

<h3 id="get-an-address-for-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_id|path|string|true|Paddle ID of the address entity to work with.|
|customer_id|path|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|Paddle ID of the customer entity to work with.|

## Update an address for a customer

<a id="opIdupdate-address"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/customers/ctm_01grnn4zta5a1mf02jjze7y2ys/addresses/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "California Office",
    "first_line": "5400 E Washington Drive, Floor 2",
    "city": "San Jose",
    "region": "CA",
    "custom_data": {
      "crm_id": "08bcfb7a-41d8-4747-9ade-3d885c287d0f"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /customers/{customer_id}/addresses/{address_id}`

Updates an address for a customer using its ID and related customer ID.

If successful, your response includes a copy of the updated address entity.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/addresses/update-address">Update an address for a customer</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "California Office",
  "first_line": "5400 E Washington Drive, Floor 2",
  "city": "San Jose",
  "region": "CA",
  "custom_data": {
    "crm_id": "08bcfb7a-41d8-4747-9ade-3d885c287d0f"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-address-for-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_id|path|string|true|Paddle ID of the address entity to work with.|
|customer_id|path|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|Paddle ID of the customer entity to work with.|
|body|body|[AddressUpdate](#schemaaddressupdate)|true|none|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Memorable description for this address.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» first_line|body|string \| null|false|First line of this address.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» second_line|body|string \| null|false|Second line of this address.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» city|body|string \| null|false|City of this address.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» postal_code|body|string \| null|false|ZIP or postal code of this address. Required for some countries.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» region|body|string \| null|false|State, county, or region of this address.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» country_code|body|object|false|Supported two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for this address.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[CountryCodeSupported](#schemacountrycodesupported)|false|Two-letter code for a country that Paddle supports sales to. Typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, though Paddle uses a small number of codes that ISO doesn't currently assign.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[CountryCodeNonSupported](#schemacountrycodenonsupported)|false|Two-letter code for a country that Paddle doesn't support sales to. Typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, though Paddle uses a small number of codes that ISO doesn't currently assign.|
|» custom_data|body|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata)|false|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» status|body|[Status](#schemastatus)|false|Whether this entity can be used in Paddle.|

<h1 id="paddle-api-account">Account</h1>

The account entity holds the business identity of the Paddle account that you're authenticated as, like its legal name, display name, and contact email address.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/account">Account overview</a>

## Get account

<a id="opIdget-account"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/account \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /account`

Returns the business identity of the account that you're authenticated as.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/account/get-account">Get account</a>

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

}
```

## Update account

<a id="opIdpatch-account"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.paddle.com/account \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "email": "billing@example.com"
  }'
```

`PATCH /account`

Updates the business identity of the account that you're authenticated as.

Send only the fields that you want to change. Fields that you omit keep their current value.

`email` is the only field that you can change. `legal_name`, `display_name`, and `website` appear
on legal and compliance documents, so only Paddle can change them. To change them, contact Paddle support.

Returns an `account_email_conflict` error if the email address is already in use by another account.

If successful, your response includes a copy of the updated account entity.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/account/patch-account">Update account</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "billing@example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="update-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AccountDetailsUpdate](#schemaaccountdetailsupdate)|true|none|
|» email|body|object|false|Contact email address for this account. Must be unique across Paddle accounts, so a value already in use returns an `account_email_conflict` error. You can't clear it, because Paddle uses it for account and payout correspondence.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "slr_01k1e8w9df9pz73s399svdkxtg",
    "legacy_id": "15839",
    "legal_name": "AeroEdit Inc.",
    "display_name": "AeroEdit",
    "website": "https://example.com",
    "email": "billing@example.com"
  },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "b2c4a1f6-3d8e-4a91-9c07-1e5f8b2d6a34"
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": {},
    "code": "not_found",
    "detail": "Entity pro_01gsz97mq9pa4fkyy0wqenepkz not found",
    "documentation_url": "https://developer.paddle.com/errors/shared/not_found",
    "errors": [
      {
        "field": "image_url",
        "message": "must be a valid image"
      }
    ]
  },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "b15ec92e-8688-40d4-a04d-f44cbec93355"
  }
}
```

## adjustment.created

<a id="opIdadjustment-created"></a>

`POST adjustment.created`

Occurs when an adjustment is created.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/adjustments/adjustment-created">adjustment.created</a>

## adjustment.updated

<a id="opIdadjustment-updated"></a>

`POST adjustment.updated`

Occurs when an adjustment is updated.

This only occurs for `refund` adjustments, which must be approved by Paddle and are created as `pending_approval`
initially. On review, they move to `approved` or `rejected` and `adjustment.updated` occurs.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/adjustments/adjustment-updated">adjustment.updated</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01hvgfdfepj8eaevsjh5g4swbe",
  "event_type": "adjustment.updated",
  "occurred_at": "2024-04-15T08:54:10.646377Z",
  "notification_id": "ntf_01hvgfdfhwncqrrjz1nz5eky9a",
  "data": {
    "id": "adj_01hvgf2s84dr6reszzg29zbvcm",
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "adjitm_01hvgf2s84dr6reszzg2gx70gj",
        "type": "partial",
        "amount": "100",
        "totals": {
          "tax": "8",
          "total": "100",
          "subtotal": "92"
        },
        "item_id": "txnitm_01hvcc94b7qgz60qmrqmbm19zw",
        "proration": null
      }
    ],
    "action": "refund",
    "type": "partial",
    "reason": "error",
    "status": "pending_approval",
    "totals": {
      "fee": "5",
      "tax": "8",
      "total": "100",
      "earnings": "87",
      "subtotal": "92",
      "currency_code": "USD",
      "retained_fee": "5"
    },
    "created_at": "2024-04-15T08:48:20.239695Z",
    "updated_at": "2024-04-15T08:54:10.646377Z",
    "customer_id": "ctm_01hv6y1jedq4p1n0yqn5ba3ky4",
    "currency_code": "USD",
    "payout_totals": {
      "fee": "5",
      "tax": "8",
      "total": "100",
      "earnings": "87",
      "subtotal": "92",
      "currency_code": "USD",
      "retained_fee": "5",
      "chargeback_fee": {
        "amount": "0",
        "original": null
      }
    },
    "transaction_id": "txn_01hvcc93znj3mpqt1tenkjb04y",
    "subscription_id": "sub_01hvccbx32q2gb40sqx7n42430",
    "credit_applied_to_balance": null,
```

## api_key_exposure.created

## discount.updated

<a id="opIddiscount-updated"></a>

`POST discount.updated`

Occurs when a discount is updated.

Payload includes the complete discount entity, except `times_used`. This field changes frequently, so isn't included in payloads. [Get a discount using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/discounts/get-discount) to see the latest value.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/discounts/discount-updated">discount.updated</a>

## price.imported

<a id="opIdprice-imported"></a>

`POST price.imported`

Occurs when a price is imported.

`created_at` and `updated_at` may be `null` in events that occurred before this field was added to price entities.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/prices/price-imported">price.imported</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01hgarz844zdfws6djn9rz6qm7",
  "event_type": "price.imported",
  "occurred_at": "2024-01-01T13:31:34.071379Z",
  "notification_id": "ntf_01hd46rrqkrbndwzrarcew6t21",
  "data": {
    "id": "pri_01gsz95g2zrkagg294kpstx54r",
    "product_id": "pro_01gsz92krfzy3hcx5h5rtgnfwz",
    "type": "standard",
    "description": "Monthly (recurring addon)",
    "name": "Monthly (recurring addon)",
    "billing_cycle": {
      "interval": "month",
      "frequency": 1
    },
    "trial_period": null,
    "tax_mode": "account_setting",
    "unit_price": {
      "amount": "25000",
      "currency_code": "USD"
    },
    "unit_price_overrides": [],
    "custom_data": null,
    "status": "active",
    "quantity": {
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 1
    },
    "import_meta": {
      "external_id": "fc1ba9bc-8ddb-11ee-b9d1-0242ac120002",
      "imported_from": "paddle_classic"
    },
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T13:31:34.071379Z",
    "updated_at": "2024-01-01T13:31:34.071379Z"
  }
}
```

## price.updated

<a id="opIdprice-updated"></a>

`POST price.updated`

Occurs when a price is updated.

`created_at` and `updated_at` may be `null` in events that occurred before this field was added to price entities.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/prices/price-updated">price.updated</a>

## product.created

<a id="opIdproduct-created"></a>

`POST product.created`

Occurs when a product is created.

`updated_at` may be `null` in events that occurred before this field was added to product entities.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/products/product-created">product.created</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01htz88y5k59y9rrv15p72dv91",
  "event_type": "product.created",
  "occurred_at": "2024-04-08T16:22:16.499189Z",
  "notification_id": "ntf_01htz88y8sg8cww5jdj4q68yq0",
  "data": {
    "id": "pro_01htz88xpr0mm7b3ta2pjkr7w2",
    "name": "AeroEdit Student",
    "type": "standard",
    "status": "active",
    "image_url": "https://paddle.s3.amazonaws.com/user/165798/bT1XUOJAQhOUxGs83cbk_pro.png",
    "custom_data": {
      "features": {
        "sso": false,
        "route_planning": true,
        "payment_by_invoice": false,
        "aircraft_performance": true,
        "compliance_monitoring": false,
        "flight_log_management": true

    "import_meta": null,
    "tax_category": "standard",
    "created_at": "2024-04-08T16:22:16.024Z",
    "updated_at": "2024-04-08T16:22:16.024Z"
```

## report.updated

<a id="opIdreport-updated"></a>

`POST report.updated`

Occurs when an report is updated.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/reports/report-updated">report.updated</a>

```json
  "event_id": "evt_01hvgdpmap3espxga4jwzb0agp",

  "notification_id": "ntf_01hvgdpmd2g0dv4vpmys3z7bc3",
  "data": {

}
```

## subscription.activated

<a id="opIdsubscription-activated"></a>

`POST subscription.activated`

Occurs when a subscription becomes active. Its `status` field changes to `active`.

This means any trial period has elapsed and Paddle has successfully billed the customer.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls` .Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-activated">subscription.activated</a>

## subscription.canceled

<a id="opIdsubscription-canceled"></a>

`POST subscription.canceled`

Occurs when a subscription is canceled. Its `status` field changes to `canceled`.

If you choose to cancel a subscription immediately, the subscription status changes to `canceled` and `subscription.canceled` occurs.

If you choose to cancel a subscription on the next billing period, Paddle creates a scheduled change to say the subscription should be canceled on the next billing date. [`subscription.updated`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-updated) occurs at this point. On the next billing date, the subscription status changes to `canceled` and `subscription.canceled` occurs.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-canceled">subscription.canceled</a>

|200|OK|Respond with an HTTP 200 status code within 5 seconds to let Paddle know that you successfully received the message.<br><br>If your server sends another kind of status code or doesn't respond, Paddle automatically retries using an exponential backoff schedule.|None|

<aside class="success">

</aside>

## subscription.created

<a id="opIdsubscription-created"></a>

`POST subscription.created`

Occurs when a subscription is created. Paddle automatically creates subscriptions for recurring items when automatically-collected transactions are `completed`, or when manually-collected transactions are `billed`.

[`subscription.trialing`](/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-trialing) or [`subscription.activated`](/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-activated) typically follow.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

It also includes a `transaction_id` field, which contains the Paddle ID of the completed or billed transaction that caused Paddle to create this subscription. You can use this match the created subscription with related transaction events [as part of provisioning](/build/subscriptions/provision-access-webhooks). Other subscription events don't include this field, and it is not returned by the API when working with subscription entities.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-created">subscription.created</a>

## subscription.imported

<a id="opIdsubscription-imported"></a>

`POST subscription.imported`

Occurs when a subscription is imported.

[`subscription.trialing`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-trialing) or [`subscription.activated`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-activated) typically follow.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-imported">subscription.imported</a>

<h3 id="subscriptionimported-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|paddle_signature|header|string|true|Signature for this request. Use to verify that webhooks come from Paddle.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» event_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this event, prefixed with `evt_`.|
|» event_type|body|string|true|Type of event sent by Paddle, in the format `entity.event_type`.|
|» occurred_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this event occurred.|
|» notification_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this notification, prefixed with `ntf_`.|
|» data|body|object|true|New or changed entity.|
|» » id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this subscription entity, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|» » status|body|string|true|Status of this subscription. Set automatically by Paddle. Use the pause subscription or cancel subscription operations to change.|
|» » customer_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this customer entity, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|» » address_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this address entity, prefixed with `add_`.|
|» » business_id|body|string \| null|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this business entity, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » currency_code|body|string|true|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.|
|» » created_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » updated_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » started_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription started. This may be different from `first_billed_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » first_billed_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was first billed. This may be different from `started_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » next_billed_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription is next scheduled to be billed.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » paused_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was paused. Set automatically by Paddle when the pause subscription operation is used. `null` if not paused.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » canceled_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was canceled. Set automatically by Paddle when the cancel subscription operation is used. `null` if not canceled.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » discount|body|object \| null|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Details of the discount applied to this subscription.|
|» » » id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this discount, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|» » » starts_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this discount was first applied. `null` for canceled subscriptions where a discount was redeemed but never applied to a transaction.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » » ends_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this discount no longer applies. Where a discount has `maximum_recurring_intervals`, this is the date of the last billing period where this discount applies. `null` where a discount recurs forever.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » » type|body|string|true|Whether this discount applies for multiple billing periods.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » collection_mode|body|string \| null|true|How payment is collected for transactions created for this subscription. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|How payment is collected. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » billing_details|body|object \| null|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|

## subscription.past_due

<a id="opIdsubscription-past_due"></a>

`POST subscription.past_due`

Occurs when a subscription has an unpaid transaction. Its `status` changes to `past_due`.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-past-due">subscription.past_due</a>

## subscription.paused

<a id="opIdsubscription-paused"></a>

`POST subscription.paused`

Occurs when a subscription is paused. Its `status` field changes to `paused`.

If you choose to pause a subscription immediately, the subscription status changes to `paused` and `subscription.paused` occurs.

If you choose to pause a subscription on the next billing period, Paddle creates a scheduled change to say the subscription should be paused on the next billing date. [`subscription.updated`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-updated) occurs at this point. On the next billing date, the subscription status changes to `paused` and `subscription.paused` occurs.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-paused">subscription.paused</a>

## subscription.resumed

<a id="opIdsubscription-resumed"></a>

`POST subscription.resumed`

Occurs when a subscription is resumed after being paused. Its status field changes to `active`.

When resumed, Paddle bills for the subscription immediately. [`transaction.created`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-created) and other transaction events occur, depending on the collection mode.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-resumed">subscription.resumed</a>

## subscription.trialing

<a id="opIdsubscription-trialing"></a>

`POST subscription.trialing`

Occurs when a subscription enters trial period.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

## subscription.updated

<a id="opIdsubscription-updated"></a>

`POST subscription.updated`

Occurs when a subscription is updated.

Payload includes the complete subscription entity, except `management_urls`. Subscription management links are temporary, so they're not included. [Get a subscription using the API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription) to get management links for a subscription.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-updated">subscription.updated</a>

<h3 id="subscriptionupdated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|paddle_signature|header|string|true|Signature for this request. Use to verify that webhooks come from Paddle.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» event_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this event, prefixed with `evt_`.|
|» event_type|body|string|true|Type of event sent by Paddle, in the format `entity.event_type`.|
|» occurred_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this event occurred.|
|» notification_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this notification, prefixed with `ntf_`.|
|» data|body|object|true|New or changed entity.|
|» » id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this subscription entity, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|» » status|body|string|true|Status of this subscription. Set automatically by Paddle. Use the pause subscription or cancel subscription operations to change.|
|» » customer_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this customer entity, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|» » address_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this address entity, prefixed with `add_`.|
|» » business_id|body|string \| null|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this business entity, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » currency_code|body|string|true|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.|
|» » created_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » updated_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » started_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription started. This may be different from `first_billed_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » first_billed_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was first billed. This may be different from `started_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » next_billed_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription is next scheduled to be billed.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » paused_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was paused. Set automatically by Paddle when the pause subscription operation is used. `null` if not paused.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » canceled_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was canceled. Set automatically by Paddle when the cancel subscription operation is used. `null` if not canceled.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » discount|body|object \| null|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Details of the discount applied to this subscription.|
|» » » id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this discount, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|» » » starts_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this discount was first applied. `null` for canceled subscriptions where a discount was redeemed but never applied to a transaction.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » » ends_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this discount no longer applies. Where a discount has `maximum_recurring_intervals`, this is the date of the last billing period where this discount applies. `null` where a discount recurs forever.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|RFC 3339 datetime string.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » » type|body|string|true|Whether this discount applies for multiple billing periods.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » collection_mode|body|string \| null|true|How payment is collected for transactions created for this subscription. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|How payment is collected. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » billing_details|body|object \| null|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » » enable_checkout|body|boolean|true|Whether the related transaction may be paid using Paddle Checkout. If omitted when creating a transaction, defaults to `false`.|
|» » » purchase_order_number|body|string|true|Customer purchase order number. Appears on invoice documents.|

## transaction.billed

<a id="opIdtransaction-billed"></a>

`POST transaction.billed`

Occurs when a transaction is billed. Its `status` field changes to `billed` and `billed_at` is populated.

Marking a transaction as billed is typically used when working with manually-collected transactions to issue an
invoice. It's not typically part of checkout workflows, where collection mode is automatic.

Transactions are marked as billed when:

* You update its status to `billed` using the API.
* You send an invoice (a manually-collected transaction) using the Paddle dashboard.

Billed transactions get an invoice number. They're considered legal records, so they can't be deleted or updated, only canceled.

[`transaction.updated`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-updated) events occur immediately after to add:

* `invoice_number`, and `invoice_id` if not already present.
* If manually-collected, the newly created `subscription_id` for any recurring items.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-billed">transaction.billed</a>

</aside>

## transaction.canceled

<a id="opIdtransaction-canceled"></a>

`POST transaction.canceled`

Occurs when a transaction is canceled. Its `status` field changes to `canceled`.

Marking a transaction as canceled is typically used when working with manually-collected transactions to say that an
invoice was created in error. It's not typically part of checkout workflows, where collection mode is automatic.

Transactions are marked as canceled when:

* You update its status to `canceled` using the API.
* You cancel an invoice (a manually-collected transaction) using the Paddle dashboard.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-canceled">transaction.canceled</a>

## transaction.completed

<a id="opIdtransaction-completed"></a>

`POST transaction.completed`

Occurs when a transaction is completed. Its status field changes to `completed`.

Transactions move to completed after they're `paid`. After a transaction is paid, Paddle starts completed transaction processing. This involves:

* Logging details of the successful payment against `transaction.payments[]`.
* Adding information about fees, earnings, and totals for payouts to the transaction entity.
* For automatically-collected transactions, creating a subscription for any recurring items and adding the related `subscription_id` to the transaction entity.
* For automatically-collected transactions, adding an `invoice_number` and `invoice_id` to the transaction entity.

[`transaction.updated`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-updated) occurs as Paddle updates a paid transaction.

When all processing is completed, a transaction is marked as completed and `transaction.completed` occurs.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-completed">transaction.completed</a>

<h3 id="transactioncompleted-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|paddle_signature|header|string|true|Signature for this request. Use to verify that webhooks come from Paddle.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» event_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this event, prefixed with `evt_`.|
|» event_type|body|string|true|Type of event sent by Paddle, in the format `entity.event_type`.|
|» occurred_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this event occurred.|
|» notification_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this notification, prefixed with `ntf_`.|
|» data|body|object|true|New or changed entity.|
|» » id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this transaction entity, prefixed with `txn_`.|
|» » status|body|string|true|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` or `canceled`, other statuses are set automatically by Paddle. Automatically-collected transactions may return `completed` if payment is captured successfully, or `past_due` if payment failed.|
|» » customer_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the customer that this transaction is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this customer entity, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » address_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the address that this transaction is for, prefixed with `add_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this address entity, prefixed with `add_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » business_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the business that this transaction is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this business entity, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » custom_data|body|object \| null|true|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » currency_code|body|string|true|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » origin|body|string|true|Describes how this transaction was created.|
|» » subscription_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the subscription that this transaction is for, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this subscription entity, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » invoice_id|body|string \| null|true|**Deprecated.** Paddle ID of the invoice that this transaction is related to, prefixed with `inv_`. Used for compatibility with the Paddle Invoice API, which is now deprecated. This field is scheduled to be removed in the next version of the Paddle API.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » invoice_number|body|string \| null|true|Invoice number for this transaction. Automatically generated by Paddle when you mark a transaction as `billed` where `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » collection_mode|body|string|true|How payment is collected for this transaction. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|» » discount_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the discount applied to this transaction, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this discount, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » billing_details|body|object \| null|true|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » » enable_checkout|body|boolean|true|Whether the related transaction may be paid using Paddle Checkout. If omitted when creating a transaction, defaults to `false`.|
|» » » purchase_order_number|body|string|true|Customer purchase order number. Appears on invoice documents.|

<h3 id="transactioncompleted-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Respond with an HTTP 200 status code within 5 seconds to let Paddle know that you successfully received the message.<br><br>If your server sends another kind of status code or doesn't respond, Paddle automatically retries using an exponential backoff schedule.|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## transaction.created

<a id="opIdtransaction-created"></a>

`POST transaction.created`

Occurs when a transaction is created. Paddle creates a transaction when:

* Customers open checkout.
* You create an invoice in the Paddle dashboard.

You may also create a transaction using the API:

* Create a manually-collected transaction to create and send an invoice.
* Create an automatically-collected transaction and pass to a checkout to collect for payment.

Where a transaction has `items`, `customer_id`, and `address_id`,
[`transaction.ready`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-ready) occurs immediately after.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-created">transaction.created</a>

> Body parameter

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Respond with an HTTP 200 status code within 5 seconds to let Paddle know that you successfully received the message.<br><br>If your server sends another kind of status code or doesn't respond, Paddle automatically retries using an exponential backoff schedule.|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## transaction.paid

<a id="opIdtransaction-paid"></a>

`POST transaction.paid`

Occurs when a transaction is paid. Its status field changes to `paid`.

Transactions are paid when payment has been captured successfully, but Paddle hasn't yet fully processed the transaction internally.

For example:

* Payout totals may not be present.
* Automatically-collected transactions for recurring items might not yet have a `subscription_id`.
* Automatically-collected transactions might not yet have an `invoice_number`.

Transactions move to `completed` and [`transaction.completed`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-completed) occurs when they're fully processed.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-paid">transaction.paid</a>

## transaction.past_due

<a id="opIdtransaction-past_due"></a>

`POST transaction.past_due`

Occurs when a transaction becomes past due. Its `status` field changes to `past_due`.

* Automatically-collected transactions for subscription renewals become past due when a payment attempt fails.
* Manually-collected transactions become past due when no payment has been received 24 hours after their due date. The due date is when the invoice was issued plus its payment terms.

The status against the related subscription for a transaction also changes to `past_due`, and
[`subscription.past_due`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-past-due) occurs.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-past-due">transaction.past_due</a>

<h3 id="transactionpastdue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Respond with an HTTP 200 status code within 5 seconds to let Paddle know that you successfully received the message.<br><br>If your server sends another kind of status code or doesn't respond, Paddle automatically retries using an exponential backoff schedule.|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## transaction.payment_failed

<a id="opIdtransaction-payment_failed"></a>

`POST transaction.payment_failed`

Occurs when a payment fails for a transaction. The `payments` array is updated with details of the payment attempt.

Typically happens for automatically-collected transactions, but may occur for manually-collected transactions
(invoices) where a customer pays using Paddle Checkout and their payment is declined.

If related to a subscription renewal:

* The transaction status changes to `past_due` and [`transaction.past_due`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-past-due)
occurs.
* The related subscription status changes to `past_due` and
[`subscription.past_due`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/subscriptions/subscription-past-due) occurs.

Manually-collected transactions are marked as `past_due` 24 hours after their due date, if no payment has been received.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-payment-failed">transaction.payment_failed</a>

## transaction.ready

<a id="opIdtransaction-ready"></a>

`POST transaction.ready`

Occurs when a transaction is ready to be billed. Its `status` field changes to `ready`.

Transactions are ready when they have all the required fields against them to be transitioned to `billed` or
`completed`. This includes `items`, `customer_id`, and `address_id`. Paddle automatically marks transactions as
`ready` when these fields are present.

When working with manually-collected transactions (invoices), [`transaction.updated`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-updated)
may occur immediately after to add `invoice_id` and `adjusted_totals`.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-ready">transaction.ready</a>

<h3 id="transactionready-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|paddle_signature|header|string|true|Signature for this request. Use to verify that webhooks come from Paddle.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» event_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this event, prefixed with `evt_`.|
|» event_type|body|string|true|Type of event sent by Paddle, in the format `entity.event_type`.|
|» occurred_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this event occurred.|
|» notification_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this notification, prefixed with `ntf_`.|
|» data|body|object|true|New or changed entity.|
|» » id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this transaction entity, prefixed with `txn_`.|
|» » status|body|string|true|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` or `canceled`, other statuses are set automatically by Paddle. Automatically-collected transactions may return `completed` if payment is captured successfully, or `past_due` if payment failed.|
|» » customer_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the customer that this transaction is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this customer entity, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » address_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the address that this transaction is for, prefixed with `add_`.|

|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » business_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the business that this transaction is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this business entity, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » custom_data|body|object \| null|true|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Your own structured key-value data.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

|» » origin|body|string|true|Describes how this transaction was created.|
|» » subscription_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the subscription that this transaction is for, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this subscription entity, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » invoice_number|body|string \| null|true|Invoice number for this transaction. Automatically generated by Paddle when you mark a transaction as `billed` where `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » collection_mode|body|string|true|How payment is collected for this transaction. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|» » discount_id|body|string \| null|true|Paddle ID of the discount applied to this transaction, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|Unique Paddle ID for this discount, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » billing_details|body|object \| null|true|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|» » » enable_checkout|body|boolean|true|Whether the related transaction may be paid using Paddle Checkout. If omitted when creating a transaction, defaults to `false`.|
|» » » purchase_order_number|body|string|true|Customer purchase order number. Appears on invoice documents.|
|» » » additional_information|body|string \| null|true|Notes or other information to include on this invoice. Appears on invoice documents.|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » » payment_terms|body|object|true|How long a customer has to pay this invoice once issued. The invoice is due at the end of its payment terms, and is marked as `past_due` 24 hours after its due date if unpaid.|
|» » » » interval|body|string|true|Unit of time.|
|» » » » frequency|body|integer|true|Amount of time.|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » billing_period|body|object \| null|true|Time period that this transaction is for. Set automatically by Paddle for subscription renewals to describe the period that charges are for.|

## transaction.updated

<a id="opIdtransaction-updated"></a>

`POST transaction.updated`

Occurs when a transaction is updated.

Specific events occur for status changes. `transaction.updated` may also occur after a status change events to add
additional fields to the transaction after Paddle has completed internal processing for a transaction.

For example, [`transaction.billed`](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-billed) occurs when a transaction status
changes to `billed`. `transaction.updated` occurs immediately after to add an `invoice_number`.

<a href="https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks/transactions/transaction-updated">transaction.updated</a>

<h3 id="transactionupdated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|paddle_signature|header|string|true|Signature for this request. Use to verify that webhooks come from Paddle.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» event_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this event, prefixed with `evt_`.|
|» event_type|body|string|true|Type of event sent by Paddle, in the format `entity.event_type`.|
|» occurred_at|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this event occurred.|
|» notification_id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this notification, prefixed with `ntf_`.|
|» data|body|object|true|New or changed entity.|
|» » id|body|string|true|Unique Paddle ID for this transaction entity, prefixed with `txn_`.|
|» » status|body|string|true|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` or `canceled`, other statuses are set automatically by Paddle. Automatically-collected transactions may return `completed` if payment is captured successfully, or `past_due` if payment failed.|

Represents the business identity of an account.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|true|read-only|Unique Paddle ID for this account, prefixed with `slr_`.|
|legacy_id|string \| null|true|read-only|Numeric ID for this account. Include this value when contacting Paddle support. Use `id` to identify this account programmatically.|
|legal_name|string \| null|true|none|Registered legal name of the business that operates this account. Shown at checkout. Only Paddle can change this, so contact Paddle support to update it.|
|display_name|string \| null|true|none|Name shown to customers on invoices, receipts, and in the Paddle customer portal. Only Paddle can change this, so contact Paddle support to update it.|
|website|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Website for the product or service sold through this account. Only Paddle can change this, so contact Paddle support to update it.|
|email|[Email](#schemaemail) \| null|true|none|Contact email address for this account. Paddle uses it for account and payout correspondence, and it may be shown to customers as a support contact.|

|detail|string|true|none|Some information about what went wrong as a human-readable string.|
|documentation_url|string(uri)|true|none|Link to a page in the error reference for this specific error.|
|errors|[[ErrorItem](#schemaerroritem)]|false|none|List of validation errors. Only returned when there's a validation error.|

```json
    "type": {},
    "code": "not_found",
    "detail": "Entity pro_01gsz97mq9pa4fkyy0wqenepkz not found",
    "documentation_url": "https://developer.paddle.com/errors/shared/not_found",
    "errors": [
      {
        "field": "image_url",
        "message": "must be a valid image"
      }
    ]
  },
  "meta": {

  }
}
```

An error occurred. Check the `type`, `code`, and `detail` in the returned error object for more information.

Validation errors include an array of `errors` with information about which fields failed validation.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|error|object|true|none|Represents an error.|
|meta|[Meta](#schemameta)|true|none|Information about this response.|

<h2 id="tocS_Pagination">Pagination</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapagination"></a>
<a id="schema_Pagination"></a>
<a id="tocSpagination"></a>
<a id="tocspagination"></a>

```json
{
  "per_page": 0,
  "next": "http://example.com",
  "has_more": true,
  "estimated_total": 999
}
```

Keys used for working with paginated results.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|per_page|integer|true|read-only|Number of entities per page for this response. May differ from the number requested if the requested number is greater than the maximum.|
|next|string(uri)|true|read-only|URL containing the query parameters of the original request, along with the `after` parameter that marks the starting point of the next page. Always returned, even if `has_more` is `false`.|
|has_more|boolean|true|read-only|Whether this response has another page.|
|estimated_total|integer|false|read-only|Estimated number of entities for this response.<br><br>For datasets with 100,000 or fewer matches, returns the exact count. For datasets with more than 100,000 matches, returns `100001` to indicate that more than 100,000 entities match. Returns `-1` when counting is skipped or couldn't be calculated.<br><br>Use `has_more` and `next` to page through all results rather than relying on `estimated_total` for an exact count.|

<a id="tocSadjustmentstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsadjustmentstatus"></a>

```json

```

Status of this adjustment. Set automatically by Paddle.

Most refunds for live accounts are created with the status of `pending_approval` until reviewed by Paddle, but some are automatically approved. For sandbox accounts, Paddle automatically approves refunds every ten minutes.

Credit adjustments don't require approval from Paddle, so they're created as `approved`.

<h2 id="tocS_TransactionTotals">TransactionTotals</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schematransactiontotals"></a>
<a id="schema_TransactionTotals"></a>

<a id="tocstransactiontotals"></a>

```json
{
  "subtotal": "15000",
  "discount": "0",
  "tax": "1500",
  "total": "16500",
  "credit": "0",
  "credit_to_balance": "0",
  "balance": "16500",
  "grand_total": "16500",
  "grand_total_tax": "83",
  "fee": "825",
  "earnings": "15675",
  "currency_code": {}
}
```

Breakdown of the total for a transaction. These numbers can be negative when dealing with subscription updates that result in credit.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subtotal|string|true|read-only|Subtotal before discount, tax, and deductions. If an item, unit price multiplied by quantity.|
|discount|string|true|read-only|Total discount as a result of any discounts applied.<br><br>Except for percentage discounts, Paddle applies tax to discounts based on the line item `price.tax_mode`. If `price.tax_mode` for a line item is `internal`, Paddle removes tax from the discount applied.|
|tax|string|true|read-only|Total tax on the subtotal.|
|total|string|true|read-only|Total after discount and tax.|
|credit|string|true|none|Total credit applied to this transaction. This includes credits applied using a customer's credit balance and adjustments to a `billed` transaction.|
|credit_to_balance|string|true|none|Additional credit generated from negative `details.line_items`. This credit is added to the customer balance.|
|balance|string|true|none|Total due on a transaction after credits and any payments.|
|grand_total|string|true|none|Total due on a transaction after credits but before any payments.|
|grand_total_tax|string|true|read-only|Net tax amount included in `grand_total`. Equals the full `tax` amount unless credits are applied, in which case this value is proportionally reduced.|
|fee|string \| null|true|none|Total fee taken by Paddle for this transaction. `null` until the transaction is `completed` and the fee is processed.|
|earnings|string \| null|true|none|Total earnings for this transaction. This is the total minus the Paddle fee. `null` until the transaction is `completed` and the fee is processed.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the currency used for this transaction.|

Customer portal deep links for this subscription.

Authenticated links are only returned when your API key has Customer portal session (Write) permission. For security, the `token` appended to authenticated links is temporary. You shouldn't store them.

### Properties

|cancel|string(uri)|true|none|Link to the page for this subscription in the customer portal with the subscription cancellation form pre-opened. Use as part of cancel subscription workflows.|
|view_subscription|string(uri)|true|none|Link to the page for this subscription in the customer portal, with no form pre-opened. Use to let customers manage the subscription themselves rather than sending them into one specific action.|

Represents a subscription item.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|object|true|read-only|Status of this subscription item. Set automatically by Paddle.|
|quantity|number|true|none|Quantity of this item on the subscription.|
|recurring|boolean|true|read-only|Whether this is a recurring item. `false` if one-time.|
|created_at|object|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this item was added to this subscription.|
|updated_at|object|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this item was last updated on this subscription.|
|previously_billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this item was last billed.|
|next_billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this item is next scheduled to be billed.|
|trial_dates|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|true|read-only|Trial dates for this item.|
|price|object|true|read-only|Related price entity for this item. This reflects the price entity at the time it was added to the subscription.|

<h2 id="tocS_CountryDefinition">CountryDefinition</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacountrydefinition"></a>
<a id="schema_CountryDefinition"></a>
<a id="tocScountrydefinition"></a>
<a id="tocscountrydefinition"></a>

```json
{
  "iso": {},
  "iso3": {},
  "name": "string",
  "printable_name": "string",
  "uses_postal_code": true,
  "transaction_currency": {},
  "payout_currency": {},
  "allow_sales": true,
  "has_regions": true,
  "tax_mode": {}
}
```

Metadata about a country that Paddle knows about.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|iso|object|true|read-only|Two-letter code for the country. Typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, though Paddle uses a small number of codes that ISO doesn't currently assign.|
|iso3|object|true|read-only|Three-letter code for the country. Typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, though Paddle uses a small number of codes that ISO doesn't currently assign.|
|name|string|true|read-only|Formal English name of the country, in uppercase ASCII characters only. Typically the ISO 3166-1 name. Use `printable_name` for display.|
|printable_name|string|true|read-only|Common English name of the country, formatted for display.|
|uses_postal_code|boolean|true|read-only|Whether Paddle requires a postal code as part of addresses in this country.|
|transaction_currency|object|true|read-only|Currency used for automatic price conversion when the customer is in this country.|
|payout_currency|object|true|read-only|Default payout currency for this country. You can set your payout currency in the dashboard, so it may differ from this default.|
|allow_sales|boolean|true|read-only|Whether Paddle supports sales to customers in this country. `false` means sales aren't permitted. This typically means a country is restricted by sanctions or policy, uses a withdrawn ISO 3166-1 code, or has no commercial applicability. Other risk and compliance checks may still prevent an individual sale.|
|has_regions|boolean|true|read-only|Whether Paddle holds region data for this country. Regions are only defined where sales are restricted below country level.|
|tax_mode|object|true|read-only|How tax is presented for prices to customers in this country by default.|

Calculated totals for a transaction, including proration, discounts, tax, and currency conversion. Considered the source of truth for totals on a transaction.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|tax_rates_used|[[TransactionDetailsTaxRatesUsedItem](#schematransactiondetailstaxratesuseditem)]|true|read-only|List of tax rates applied for this transaction.|
|totals|[TransactionTotals](#schematransactiontotals)|true|none|Breakdown of the total for a transaction. These numbers can be negative when dealing with subscription updates that result in credit.|
|adjusted_totals|[TransactionTotalsAdjusted](#schematransactiontotalsadjusted)|true|read-only|Breakdown of the totals for a transaction after adjustments.|
|payout_totals|[TransactionPayoutTotals](#schematransactionpayouttotals) \| null|true|none|Breakdown of the payout total for a transaction. `null` until the transaction is `completed`. Returned in your payout currency.|
|adjusted_payout_totals|[TransactionPayoutTotalsAdjusted](#schematransactionpayouttotalsadjusted) \| null|true|none|Breakdown of the payout total for a transaction after adjustments. `null` until the transaction is `completed`.|
|line_items|[[TransactionDetailsLineItem](#schematransactiondetailslineitem)]|true|none|Information about line items for this transaction. Different from transaction `items` as they include totals calculated by Paddle. Considered the source of truth for line item totals.|
