Represents a transaction entity.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|true|read-only|none|
|status|[TransactionStatus](#schematransactionstatus)|true|none|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` or `canceled`, other statuses are set automatically by Paddle. Automatically-collected transactions may return `completed` if payment is captured successfully, or `past_due` if payment failed.|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this transaction is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|address_id|[AddressId](#schemaaddressid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the address that this transaction is for, prefixed with `add_`.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the business that this transaction is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|true|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|origin|object|true|none|Describes how this transaction was created.|
|subscription_id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the subscription that this transaction is for, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|invoice_id|string \| null|true|read-only|**Deprecated.** Paddle ID of the invoice that this transaction is related to, prefixed with `inv_`. Used for compatibility with the Paddle Invoice API, which is now deprecated. This field is scheduled to be removed in the next version of the Paddle API.|
|invoice_number|[DocumentNumber](#schemadocumentnumber) \| null|true|none|Invoice number for this transaction. Automatically generated by Paddle when you mark a transaction as `billed` where `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|collection_mode|object|true|none|How payment is collected for this transaction. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|discount_id|[DiscountId](#schemadiscountid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the discount applied to this transaction, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetails](#schemabillingdetails) \| null|true|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|billing_period|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|true|none|Time period that this transaction is for. Set automatically by Paddle for subscription renewals to describe the period that charges are for.|
|items|[[TransactionItem](#schematransactionitem)]|true|none|List of items on this transaction. For calculated totals, use `details.line_items`.|
|details|object|true|read-only|none|
|payments|[[TransactionPaymentAttempt](#schematransactionpaymentattempt)]|true|read-only|List of payment attempts for this transaction, including successful payments. Sorted by `created_at` in descending order, so most recent attempts are returned first.|
|checkout|[TransactionCheckout](#schematransactioncheckout) \| null|true|none|none|
|created_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this transaction was marked as `billed`. `null` for transactions that aren't `billed` or `completed`. Set automatically by Paddle.|
|revised_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when a transaction was revised. Revisions describe an update to customer information for a billed or completed transaction. `null` if not revised. Set automatically by Paddle.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|draft|
|status|ready|
|status|billed|
|status|paid|
|status|completed|
|status|canceled|
|status|past_due|

Represents a discount entity when creating discounts.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|false|read-only|none|
|status|object|false|read-only|none|
|description|string|true|none|Short description for this discount for your reference. Not shown to customers.|
|enabled_for_checkout|boolean|false|none|Whether this discount can be redeemed by customers at checkout (`true`) or not (`false`).|
|code|[DiscountCode](#schemadiscountcode) \| null|false|none|Unique code that customers can use to redeem this discount at checkout. Use letters and numbers only, up to 32 characters. Not case-sensitive.<br><br>If omitted and `enabled_for_checkout` is `true`, Paddle generates a random 10-character code.|
|type|object|true|none|Type of discount. Determines how this discount impacts the checkout or transaction total.|
|mode|object|false|none|Discount mode. Standard discounts are considered part of your catalog and are shown in the Paddle dashboard. If omitted, defaults to `standard`.|
|amount|string|true|none|Amount to discount by. For `percentage` discounts, must be an amount between `0.01` and `100`. For `flat` and `flat_per_seat` discounts, amount in the lowest denomination for a currency.|
|currency_code|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode) \| null|false|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Required where discount type is `flat` or `flat_per_seat`.|
|recur|boolean|false|none|Whether this discount applies for multiple subscription billing periods (`true`) or not (`false`). If omitted, defaults to `false`.|
|maximum_recurring_intervals|integer \| null|false|none|Number of subscription billing periods that this discount recurs for. Requires `recur`. `null` if this discount recurs forever.<br><br>Subscription renewals, midcycle changes, and one-time charges billed to a subscription aren't considered a redemption. `times_used` is not incremented in these cases.|
|usage_limit|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum number of times this discount can be redeemed. This is an overall limit for this discount, rather than a per-customer limit. `null` if this discount can be redeemed an unlimited amount of times.<br><br>Paddle counts a usage as a redemption on a checkout, transaction, or the initial application against a subscription. Transactions created for subscription renewals, midcycle changes, and one-time charges aren't considered a redemption.<br><br>Paddle checks this limit when a discount is applied to a checkout or transaction, comparing it against `times_used` at that moment. As `times_used` only increments when a transaction completes, checkouts that are open at the same time can each pass this check, so in some cases a discount may be redeemed more times than this limit allows.|
|restrict_to|[[DiscountRestrictTo](#schemadiscountrestrictto)] \| null|false|none|Product or price IDs that this discount is for. When including a product ID, all prices for that product can be discounted. `null` if this discount applies to all products and prices.|
|expires_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|false|none|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this discount expires. Discount can no longer be redeemed after this date has elapsed. `null` if this discount can be redeemed forever.<br><br>Expired discounts can't be redeemed against transactions or checkouts, but can be applied when updating subscriptions.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|times_used|integer|false|read-only|How many times this discount has been redeemed. Automatically incremented by Paddle.<br><br>Paddle counts a usage as a redemption on a checkout, transaction, or subscription. Transactions created for subscription renewals, midcycle changes, and one-time charges aren't considered a redemption.<br><br>Incremented when a transaction completes, rather than when a discount is applied to a checkout. See `usage_limit` for how this affects enforcement of the limit.|
|created_at|object|false|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|false|read-only|none|
|discount_group_id|[DiscountGroupId](#schemadiscountgroupid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID for the discount group related to this discount, prefixed with `dsg_`. `null` if not in a discount group.|
|import_meta|[ImportMeta](#schemaimportmeta) \| null|false|none|Import information for this entity. `null` if this entity is not imported.|

|times_used|integer|false|read-only|How many times this discount has been redeemed. Automatically incremented by Paddle.<br><br>Paddle counts a usage as a redemption on a checkout, transaction, or subscription. Transactions created for subscription renewals, midcycle changes, and one-time charges aren't considered a redemption.<br><br>Incremented when a transaction completes, rather than when a discount is applied to a checkout. See `usage_limit` for how this affects enforcement of the limit.|

<a id="tocsmetricsexploreseries"></a>

```json
{
  "dimensions": {},
  "timeseries": [
    {
      "timestamp": "2026-02-01",
      "measures": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

One segment (dimension combination) and its full time series. `per_page` caps the number of series, never the number of datapoints within a series.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|dimensions|object|true|none|Dimension values for this segment, keyed by a subset of the requested dimensions. Empty for a result with no breakdown applied.|
|timeseries|[[MetricsExploreDataPoint](#schemametricsexploredatapoint)]|true|none|Time series for this segment. One entry per time bucket, ordered chronologically.|

Result set for an Explore query: a self-describing schema plus one timeseries per segment, with optional totals.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|entity|object|true|none|Entity name for the metric that was queried.|
|interval|object|true|none|Time bucketing applied to the result.|
|currency_code|object|false|none|Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for values in the response. Derived from your balance currency. Omitted when the response has no currency values.|
|starts_at|object|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string of the start of the queried range, in UTC. Matches the `from` in your request.|
|ends_at|object|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string of the end of the queried range, in UTC. Matches the `to` in your request, clamped to the current time if it's in the future.|
|updated_at|object|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string of when the data behind this metric was last refreshed, in UTC. Set automatically by Paddle.|
|fields|object|true|none|Describes the dimension and measure fields in this result.|
|series|[[MetricsExploreSeries](#schemametricsexploreseries)]|true|none|One entry per segment (dimension combination), each carrying its full time series. Capped by `per_page`.|

<h2 id="tocS_MetricsExplorePagination">MetricsExplorePagination</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemametricsexplorepagination"></a>
<a id="schema_MetricsExplorePagination"></a>
<a id="tocSmetricsexplorepagination"></a>
<a id="tocsmetricsexplorepagination"></a>

```json
{
  "per_page": 0,
  "next": "http://example.com",
  "has_more": true,
  "estimated_total": 42
}
```

Pagination state for the list of segments. Because this operation paginates with `POST`, `next` is a URL carrying an `after` query parameter. Send the same request body to it to get the next page.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|per_page|integer|true|none|Number of series per page for this response. May differ from the number requested if the requested number is greater than the maximum.|
|next|string(uri)|true|none|URL for the next page, including the `after` query parameter. Always returned, even when `has_more` is `false`. Re-POST the unchanged query body to this URL. Use `has_more` to decide whether another page exists.|
|has_more|boolean|true|none|Whether this response has another page.|
|estimated_total|integer|true|none|Total number of series for this response. Returns the exact count, even when the query's result set was truncated by its 1,000,000 row cap.|

<h2 id="tocS_MetricsExploreMeasure">MetricsExploreMeasure</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemametricsexploremeasure"></a>
<a id="schema_MetricsExploreMeasure"></a>
<a id="tocSmetricsexploremeasure"></a>
<a id="tocsmetricsexploremeasure"></a>

```json
{
  "field": "gross_revenue",
  "agg": "count"
}
```

A measure to compute: a measure `field`, optionally with the `agg` to apply. Each entity defines which aggregations are allowed for each field. Derived measures (`aggs: null` in the entity's metadata) omit `agg`. Paddle names the returned measure `{agg}_{field}`, or `{field}` for derived measures.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|field|string|true|none|Measure field. An unknown field returns `unknown_field`.|
|agg|[MetricsAggregation](#schemametricsaggregation) \| null|false|none|Aggregation to apply. Must be allowed for this field, otherwise `invalid_aggregation`. Omit for derived measures.|

<h2 id="tocS_MetricsExploreFilter">MetricsExploreFilter</h2>

<a id="schemametricsexplorefilter"></a>

<a id="tocSmetricsexplorefilter"></a>
<a id="tocsmetricsexplorefilter"></a>

```json
{
  "field": "country",
  "op": {},
  "value": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

A filter applied to a dimensional field. With the `in` operator, `value` is the array of values to match.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|field|string|true|none|Dimension field to filter on. An unknown field returns `unknown_field`.|
|op|object|true|none|Comparison operator. Must be valid for the field, otherwise `invalid_operator`. Only `in` is supported for now.|
|value|[string]|true|none|The array of values to match for the `in` operator.|

<h2 id="tocS_MetricsExploreRequest">MetricsExploreRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemametricsexplorerequest"></a>
<a id="schema_MetricsExploreRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSmetricsexplorerequest"></a>
<a id="tocsmetricsexplorerequest"></a>

```json
{
  "entity": {},
  "from": "2026-01-01",
  "to": "2026-04-01",
  "measures": [
    {
      "field": "gross_revenue",
      "agg": "count"
    }
  ],
  "interval": "month",
  "dimensions": [],
  "filters": [],
  "order_by": [
    {
      "field": "gross_revenue",
      "dir": {}
    }
  ],
  "per_page": 5
}
```

A JSON query against a single metric entity. Results are automatically scoped to your account.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|entity|object|true|none|Entity name for the metric to query. One metric per request. An unknown value, including `subscriptions` in sandbox, returns `unknown_entity`.|
|from|string|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string or `YYYY-MM-DD` date for the start of the range, interpreted at 00:00 UTC. Inclusive. Must be within the metric's `max_lookback_days`, otherwise Paddle returns `max_lookback_exceeded`.|
|to|string|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string or `YYYY-MM-DD` date for the end of the range, interpreted at 00:00 UTC. Exclusive. Clamped to the current time if in the future.|
|measures|[[MetricsExploreMeasure](#schemametricsexploremeasure)]|true|none|One or more measures to compute.|
|interval|object|false|none|Interval that results are bucketed by. Every query is bucketed, so each entry in `timeseries` carries a `timestamp`.|
|dimensions|[string]|false|none|Dimensions to group results by. Each combination of values returns as a segment. `timestamp` is implied by `interval`, so don't include it here.|
|filters|[[MetricsExploreFilter](#schemametricsexplorefilter)]|false|none|Filters to narrow results by dimension. Multiple filters are combined, so results must match all of them.|
|order_by|[[MetricsExploreOrderBy](#schemametricsexploreorderby)]|false|none|Ordering. Required when you pass `dimensions`, because it decides which segments land on the page. Omitting it on a query with dimensions returns `invalid_field`.|
|per_page|integer|false|none|Number of segments returned per page, not datapoints. Each segment carries its complete timeseries. Paddle returns the maximum if you request more, so check `meta.pagination.per_page` to see how many came back. A page can hold at most 10,000 datapoints (`per_page` multiplied by the time buckets in your range), otherwise Paddle returns `too_many_datapoints`.<br><br>Default: `5`; Maximum: `50`.|

A single datapoint in a checkout conversion metrics timeseries.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|timestamp|object|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string for this datapoint.|
|count|integer|true|none|Total number of checkouts in this period.|
|completed_count|integer|true|none|Number of checkouts completed in this period.|
|rate|string|true|none|Conversion rate for this period. Calculated by dividing `completed_count` by `count`.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|false|none|none|
|description|string|true|none|Internal description for this price, not shown to customers. Typically notes for your team.|

|name|[PriceName](#schemapricename) \| null|false|none|none|
|product_id|object|true|none|Paddle ID for the product that this price is for, prefixed with `pro_`.|
|billing_cycle|[Duration](#schemaduration) \| null|false|none|How often this price should be charged. `null` if price is non-recurring (one-time). If omitted, defaults to `null`.|
|trial_period|[PriceTrialDurationCreate](#schemapricetrialdurationcreate) \| null|false|none|Trial period for the product related to this price. The billing cycle begins once the trial period is over.<br>`null` for no trial period. Requires `billing_cycle`. If omitted, defaults to `null`.|

Filter criteria for this report. If no `gte` filter for `updated_at` is passed when creating, reports are filtered to include data updated in the last month. This means `updated_at` is greater than or equal to (`gte`) the same date and time one calendar month before the report was generated, so the window is between 28 and 31 days depending on the month.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|object|true|none|Field name to filter by.|
|operator|[Operator](#schemaoperator) \| null|true|none|Operator to use when filtering. Valid when filtering by `updated_at`, `null` otherwise.|
|value|[[AdjustmentStatus](#schemaadjustmentstatus)] \| [[AdjustmentAction](#schemaadjustmentaction)] \| [Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| string(date) \| [string] \| string|true|none|Value to filter by. Check the allowed values descriptions for the `name` field to see valid values for a field.|

Filter criteria for this report. If no `gte` filter for `updated_at` is passed when creating, reports are filtered to include data updated in the last month. This means `updated_at` is greater than or equal to (`gte`) the same date and time one calendar month before the report was generated, so the window is between 28 and 31 days depending on the month.

Represents a subscription history entry.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|true|read-only|Unique Paddle ID for this subscription history entry, prefixed with `subhis_`.|
|group_id|object|true|read-only|Unique Paddle ID for this subscription history group, prefixed with `subhisgrp_`. History entries that occurred as part of the same request share the same group ID.|
|subscription_id|object|true|read-only|Paddle ID of the subscription that this history entry relates to, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|occurred_at|object|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when the entry happened.|
|source|object|true|read-only|Where the entry originated from.|
|actor|object|true|read-only|Details about the actor that performed the action that created this entry.|
|reason|object|true|read-only|Why the entry was created. Only applicable to certain actions; `null` otherwise.|
|detail|object|true|read-only|Details specific to the action. The fields returned depend on the value of `action`.|

Represents a subscription entity with included entities.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|true|none|none|
|status|object|true|none|none|
|customer_id|object|true|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this subscription is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|address_id|object|true|none|Paddle ID of the address that this subscription is for, prefixed with `add_`.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the business that this subscription is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Transactions for this subscription are created in this currency. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|created_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|started_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription started. This may be different from `first_billed_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|first_billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was first billed. This may be different from `started_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|next_billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription is next scheduled to be billed.|
|paused_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was paused. Set automatically by Paddle when the pause subscription operation is used. `null` if not paused.|
|canceled_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was canceled. Set automatically by Paddle when the cancel subscription operation is used. `null` if not canceled.|
|discount|[SubscriptionDiscount](#schemasubscriptiondiscount) \| null|true|none|Details of the discount applied to this subscription.|
|collection_mode|object|true|none|How payment is collected for transactions created for this subscription. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetails](#schemabillingdetails) \| null|true|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|current_billing_period|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|true|read-only|Current billing period for this subscription. Set automatically by Paddle based on the billing cycle. `null` for `paused` and `canceled` subscriptions.|
|billing_cycle|object|true|read-only|How often this subscription renews. Set automatically by Paddle based on the prices on this subscription.|
|scheduled_change|[SubscriptionScheduledChange](#schemasubscriptionscheduledchange) \| null|true|none|Change that's scheduled to be applied to a subscription. Represents a subscription entity when updating subscriptions.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer_id|object|false|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this subscription is for, prefixed with `ctm_`. Include to change the customer for a subscription.|
|address_id|object|false|none|Paddle ID of the address that this subscription is for, prefixed with `add_`. Include to change the address for a subscription.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the business that this subscription is for, prefixed with `biz_`. Include to change the business for a subscription.|
|currency_code|object|false|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Include to change the currency that a subscription bills in. When changing `collection_mode` to `manual`, you may need to change currency code to `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP`.|
|next_billed_at|object|false|none|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription is next scheduled to be billed. Include to change the next billing date.|
|discount|[SubscriptionUpdateDiscount](#schemasubscriptionupdatediscount) \| null|false|none|Details of the discount applied to this subscription. Include to add a discount to a subscription. `null` to remove a discount.|
|collection_mode|object|false|none|How payment is collected for transactions created for this subscription. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetailsUpdate](#schemabillingdetailsupdate) \| null|false|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`. `null` if changing `collection_mode` to `automatic`.|
|scheduled_change|null|false|none|Change that's scheduled to be applied to a subscription. When updating, you may only set to `null` to remove a scheduled change. Use the pause subscription, cancel subscription, and resume subscription operations to create scheduled changes.|
|items|[[SubscriptionUpdateItems](#schemasubscriptionupdateitems)]|false|none|List of items on this subscription. Only recurring items may be added. Send the complete list of items that should be on this subscription, including existing items to retain.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|proration_billing_mode|[SubscriptionUpdateProrationBillingMode](#schemasubscriptionupdateprorationbillingmode)|false|none|How Paddle should handle proration calculation for changes made to a subscription or its items. Required when making<br>changes that impact billing.<br><br>For automatically-collected subscriptions, responses may take longer than usual if a proration billing mode that<br>collects for payment immediately is used.|
|on_payment_failure|object|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|proration_billing_mode|prorated_immediately|
|proration_billing_mode|prorated_next_billing_period|
|proration_billing_mode|full_immediately|
|proration_billing_mode|full_next_billing_period|
|proration_billing_mode|do_not_bill|

Details of the result of credits and charges. Where the total of any credit adjustments is greater than the total charge, the result is a prorated credit; otherwise, the result is a prorated charge.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|action|object|true|none|Whether the subscription change results in a prorated credit or a charge.|
|amount|string|true|none|Amount representing the result of this update, either a charge or a credit.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction or adjustment.|

Impact of this subscription change. Includes whether the change results in a charge or credit, and totals for prorated amounts.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|credit|object|true|none|Details of any credit adjustments created for this update. Paddle creates adjustments against existing transactions when prorating.|
|charge|object|true|none|Details of the transaction to be created for this update. Paddle creates a transaction to bill for new charges.|
|result|object|true|none|Details of the result of credits and charges. Where the total of any credit adjustments is greater than the total charge, the result is a prorated credit; otherwise, the result is a prorated charge.|

Represents a subscription preview when previewing a subscription.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|object|true|none|none|
|customer_id|object|true|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this subscription is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|address_id|object|true|none|Paddle ID of the address that this subscription is for, prefixed with `add_`.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the business that this subscription is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Transactions for this subscription are created in this currency. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|created_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|started_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription started. This may be different from `first_billed_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|first_billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was first billed. This may be different from `started_at` if the subscription started in trial.|
|next_billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|none|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription is next scheduled to be billed.|
|paused_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was paused. Set automatically by Paddle when the pause subscription operation is used. `null` if not paused.|
|canceled_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this subscription was canceled. Set automatically by Paddle when the cancel subscription operation is used. `null` if not canceled.|
|discount|[SubscriptionDiscount](#schemasubscriptiondiscount) \| null|true|none|Details of the discount applied to this subscription.|
|collection_mode|object|true|none|How payment is collected for transactions created for this subscription. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetails](#schemabillingdetails) \| null|true|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|current_billing_period|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|true|read-only|Current billing period for this subscription. Set automatically by Paddle based on the billing cycle. `null` for `paused` and `canceled` subscriptions.|
|billing_cycle|object|true|read-only|How often this subscription renews. Set automatically by Paddle based on the prices on this subscription.|
|scheduled_change|[SubscriptionScheduledChange](#schemasubscriptionscheduledchange) \| null|true|none|Change that's scheduled to be applied to a subscription. Use the pause subscription, cancel subscription, and resume subscription operations to create scheduled changes. `null` if no scheduled changes.|
|management_urls|object|true|read-only|none|
|items|[[ItemSubscription](#schemaitemsubscription)]|true|read-only|List of items on this subscription. Only recurring items are returned.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|true|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|immediate_transaction|[SubscriptionNextTransaction](#schemasubscriptionnexttransaction) \| null|true|read-only|Preview of the immediate transaction created as a result of changes to the subscription. Returns a complete object where `proration_billing_mode` is `prorated_immediately` or `full_immediately`; `null` otherwise.|
|next_transaction|[SubscriptionNextTransaction](#schemasubscriptionnexttransaction) \| null|true|read-only|Preview of the next transaction for this subscription. Includes charges created where `proration_billing_mode` is `prorated_next_billing_period` or `full_next_billing_period`, as well as one-time charges. `null` if the subscription is scheduled to cancel or pause.|
|recurring_transaction_details|object|true|read-only|Preview of the recurring transaction for this subscription. This is what the customer can expect to be billed when there are no prorated or one-time charges.|
|update_summary|[UpdateSummary](#schemaupdatesummary) \| null|true|read-only|none|
|import_meta|[ImportMetaSubscription](#schemaimportmetasubscription) \| null|true|none|Import information for this entity. `null` if this entity is not imported.|
|consent_requirements|[[SubscriptionConsentRequirement](#schemasubscriptionconsentrequirement)]|true|none|List of active consent requirements for the subscription's current billing period.|


Breakdown of all the adjustments made against a transaction in the transaction currency.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subtotal|string|true|read-only|Total before tax.|
|tax|string|true|read-only|Total tax on the subtotal.|
|total|string|true|read-only|Total after tax.|
|fee|string|true|read-only|Total fee taken by Paddle.|
|retained_fee|string|true|read-only|Total gateway fee retained by Paddle.|
|earnings|string|true|read-only|Total earnings. This is the subtotal minus the fee.<br>For tax adjustments, this value is negative, which means a positive effect in the transaction earnings.<br>This is because the fee is originally calculated from the transaction total, so if a tax adjustment is made,<br>then the fee portion of it is returned.<br>As a result, the earnings from all the adjustments performed could be either negative, positive or zero.|
|breakdown|object|true|none|Breakdown of the total adjustments by adjustment action.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code used for adjustments for this transaction.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|true|read-only|none|
|status|[TransactionStatus](#schematransactionstatus)|true|none|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` or `canceled`, other statuses are set automatically by Paddle. Automatically-collected transactions may return `completed` if payment is captured successfully, or `past_due` if payment failed.|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this transaction is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|address_id|[AddressId](#schemaaddressid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the address that this transaction is for, prefixed with `add_`.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the business that this transaction is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|true|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|origin|object|true|none|Describes how this transaction was created.|
|subscription_id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the subscription that this transaction is for, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|invoice_id|string \| null|true|read-only|**Deprecated.** Paddle ID of the invoice that this transaction is related to, prefixed with `inv_`. Used for compatibility with the Paddle Invoice API, which is now deprecated. This field is scheduled to be removed in the next version of the Paddle API.|
|invoice_number|[DocumentNumber](#schemadocumentnumber) \| null|true|none|Invoice number for this transaction. Automatically generated by Paddle when you mark a transaction as `billed` where `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|collection_mode|object|true|none|How payment is collected for this transaction. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|discount_id|[DiscountId](#schemadiscountid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the discount applied to this transaction, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetails](#schemabillingdetails) \| null|true|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|billing_period|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|true|none|Time period that this transaction is for. Set automatically by Paddle for subscription renewals to describe the period that charges are for.|
|items|[[TransactionItem](#schematransactionitem)]|true|none|List of items on this transaction. For calculated totals, use `details.line_items`.|
|details|object|true|read-only|none|
|payments|[[TransactionPaymentAttempt](#schematransactionpaymentattempt)]|true|read-only|List of payment attempts for this transaction, including successful payments. Sorted by `created_at` in descending order, so most recent attempts are returned first.|
|checkout|[TransactionCheckout](#schematransactioncheckout) \| null|true|none|none|
|created_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this transaction was marked as `billed`. `null` for transactions that aren't `billed` or `completed`. Set automatically by Paddle.|
|revised_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when a transaction was revised. Revisions describe an update to customer information for a billed or completed transaction. `null` if not revised. Set automatically by Paddle.|
|customer|object|false|none|Related customer for this transaction. Only returned if the API key has a Customers (Read) permission.|
|address|object|false|none|Related address for this transaction. Only returned if the API key has an Addresses (Read) permission.|
|business|object|false|none|Related business for this transaction. Only returned if a business exists for this transaction and the API key has a Businesses (Read) permission.|
|discount|object|false|none|Related discount for this transaction. Only returned if a discount exists for this transaction and the API key has a Discounts (Read) permission.|
|adjustments|[[Adjustment](#schemaadjustment)]|true|none|Related adjustments for this transaction. Only returned if adjustments exist for this transaction and the API key has an Adjustments (Read) permission.|
|adjustments_totals|object|false|none|Object containing totals for all adjustments on this transaction. Only returned if the API key has an Adjustments (Read) permission.|
|available_payment_methods|[[PaymentMethodType](#schemapaymentmethodtype)]|true|none|List of payment methods available for this transaction.|

```json
      }
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|product_id|object|true|none|Paddle ID for the product that this price is for, prefixed with `pro_`.|
|description|string|true|none|Internal description for this price, not shown to customers. Typically notes for your team.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|Name of this price, shown to customers at checkout and on invoices. Typically describes how often the related product bills.|
|tax_mode|object|false|none|none|
|unit_price|object|true|none|Base price. This price applies to all customers, except for customers located in countries where you have `unit_price_overrides`.|
|unit_price_overrides|[[UnitPriceOverride](#schemaunitpriceoverride)]|false|none|List of unit price overrides. Use to override the base price with a custom price and currency for a country or group of countries.|
|quantity|object|false|none|Limits on how many times the related product can be purchased at this price. Useful for discount campaigns. If omitted, defaults to 1-100.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|none|Your own structured key-value data.|

Represents a transaction entity with included entities.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|true|read-only|none|
|status|[TransactionStatus](#schematransactionstatus)|true|none|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` or `canceled`, other statuses are set automatically by Paddle. Automatically-collected transactions may return `completed` if payment is captured successfully, or `past_due` if payment failed.|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this transaction is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|address_id|[AddressId](#schemaaddressid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the address that this transaction is for, prefixed with `add_`.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the business that this transaction is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|true|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|currency_code|object|true|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|origin|object|true|none|Describes how this transaction was created.|
|subscription_id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the subscription that this transaction is for, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|invoice_id|string \| null|true|read-only|**Deprecated.** Paddle ID of the invoice that this transaction is related to, prefixed with `inv_`. Used for compatibility with the Paddle Invoice API, which is now deprecated. This field is scheduled to be removed in the next version of the Paddle API.|
|invoice_number|[DocumentNumber](#schemadocumentnumber) \| null|true|none|Invoice number for this transaction. Automatically generated by Paddle when you mark a transaction as `billed` where `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|collection_mode|object|true|none|How payment is collected for this transaction. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|discount_id|[DiscountId](#schemadiscountid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID of the discount applied to this transaction, prefixed with `dsc_`.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetails](#schemabillingdetails) \| null|true|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|billing_period|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|true|none|Time period that this transaction is for. Set automatically by Paddle for subscription renewals to describe the period that charges are for.|
|items|[[TransactionItem](#schematransactionitem)]|true|none|List of items on this transaction. For calculated totals, use `details.line_items`.|
|details|object|true|read-only|none|
|payments|[[TransactionPaymentAttempt](#schematransactionpaymentattempt)]|true|read-only|List of payment attempts for this transaction, including successful payments. Sorted by `created_at` in descending order, so most recent attempts are returned first.|
|checkout|[TransactionCheckout](#schematransactioncheckout) \| null|true|none|none|
|created_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this transaction was marked as `billed`. `null` for transactions that aren't `billed` or `completed`. Set automatically by Paddle.|
|revised_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|true|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when a transaction was revised. Revisions describe an update to customer information for a billed or completed transaction. `null` if not revised. Set automatically by Paddle.|
|address|object|false|none|Address for this transaction. Reflects the entity at the time it was added to the transaction, or its revision if `revised_at` is not `null`. Returned when the `include` parameter is used with the `address` value and the transaction has an `address_id`.|
|adjustments|[[Adjustment](#schemaadjustment)]|false|none|List of adjustments for this transaction. Returned when the `include` parameter is used with the `adjustment` value and the transaction has adjustments.|
|adjustments_totals|object|false|none|Object containing totals for all adjustments on a transaction. Returned when the `include` parameter is used with the `adjustments_totals` value.|
|business|object|false|none|Business for this transaction. Reflects the entity at the time it was added to the transaction, or its revision if `revised_at` is not `null`. Returned when the `include` parameter is used with the `business` value and the transaction has a `business_id`.|
|customer|object|false|none|Customer for this transaction. Reflects the entity at the time it was added to the transaction, or its revision if `revised_at` is not `null`. Returned when the `include` parameter is used with the `customer` value and the transaction has a `customer_id`.|
|discount|object|false|none|Discount for this transaction. Reflects the entity at the time it was added to the transaction. Returned when the `include` parameter is used with the `discount` value and the transaction has a `discount_id`.|
|available_payment_methods|[[PaymentMethodType](#schemapaymentmethodtype)]|false|read-only|List of available payment methods for this transaction. Returned when the `include` parameter is used with the `available_payment_methods` value.|

Represents a discount entity for a custom, non-catalog discount.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|description|string|true|none|Short description for this discount for your reference. Not shown to customers.|
|type|object|true|none|Type of discount. Determines how this discount impacts the checkout or transaction total.|
|amount|string|true|none|Amount to discount by. For `percentage` discounts, must be an amount between `0.01` and `100`. For `flat` and `flat_per_seat` discounts, amount in the lowest denomination for a currency.|
|recur|boolean|false|none|Whether this discount applies for multiple subscription billing periods (`true`) or not (`false`). If omitted, defaults to `false`.|
|maximum_recurring_intervals|integer \| null|false|none|Number of subscription billing periods that this discount recurs for. Requires `recur`. `null` if this discount recurs forever.<br><br>Subscription renewals, midcycle changes, and one-time charges billed to a subscription aren't considered a redemption. `times_used` is not incremented in these cases.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|restrict_to|[string] \| null|false|none|Product or price IDs that this discount is for. When including a product ID, all prices for that product can be discounted. `null` if this discount applies to all products and prices.|

Represents a transaction entity when creating transactions.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|false|read-only|none|
|status|object|false|none|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` when creating,<br>or omit to let Paddle set the status. Transactions are created as `ready` if they have<br>an `address_id`, `customer_id`, and `items`, otherwise they are created as `draft`.<br><br>Marking as `billed` when creating is typically used when working with manually-collected<br>transactions as part of an invoicing workflow. Billed transactions cannot be updated, only canceled.|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this transaction is for, prefixed with `ctm_`. If omitted, transaction status is `draft`.|
|address_id|[AddressId](#schemaaddressid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the address that this transaction is for, prefixed with `add_`. Requires `customer_id`. If omitted, transaction status is `draft`.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the business that this transaction is for, prefixed with `biz_`. Requires `customer_id`. |
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|currency_code|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode) \| null|false|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|origin|object|false|none|none|
|subscription_id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the subscription that this transaction is for, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|invoice_id|string \| null|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Paddle ID of the invoice that this transaction is related to, prefixed with `inv_`. Used for compatibility with the Paddle Invoice API, which is now deprecated. This field is scheduled to be removed in the next version of the Paddle API.|
|invoice_number|string \| null|false|read-only|Invoice number for this transaction. Automatically generated by Paddle when you mark a transaction as `billed` where `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|collection_mode|object|false|none|How payment is collected for this transaction. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices. If omitted, defaults to `automatic`.|
|discount_id|[DiscountId](#schemadiscountid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the discount to apply to this transaction, prefixed with `dsc_`. Send one of `discount_id` or `discount`.|
|discount|[DiscountCustom](#schemadiscountcustom) \| null|false|none|Apply a non-catalog discount to a transaction. Send one of `discount_id` or `discount`.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetailsCreate](#schemabillingdetailscreate) \| null|false|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|billing_period|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|false|none|Time period that this transaction is for. Set automatically by Paddle for subscription renewals to describe the period that charges are for.|
|items|[[TransactionItemCreate](#schematransactionitemcreate)]|true|none|List of items to charge for. You can charge for items that you've added to your catalog by passing the Paddle ID of an existing price entity, or you can charge for non-catalog items by passing a price object.<br><br>Non-catalog items can be for existing products, or you can pass a product object as part of your price to charge for a non-catalog product.|
|details|object|false|read-only|none|
|payments|[[TransactionPaymentAttempt](#schematransactionpaymentattempt)]|false|read-only|List of payment attempts for this transaction, including successful payments. Sorted by `created_at` in descending order, so most recent attempts are returned first.|
|checkout|[TransactionCheckoutCreate](#schematransactioncheckoutcreate) \| null|false|none|Paddle Checkout details for this transaction. You may pass a URL when creating or updating an automatically-collected transaction, or when creating or updating a manually-collected transaction where `billing_details.enable_checkout` is `true`.|
|created_at|object|false|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|false|read-only|none|
|billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|false|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this transaction was marked as `billed`. `null` for transactions that aren't `billed` or `completed`. Set automatically by Paddle.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[TransactionItemCreateWithPriceId](#schematransactionitemcreatewithpriceid)|false|none|Add a catalog item to a transaction. In this case, the product and price that you're billing for exist in your product catalog in Paddle.|
|*oneOf*|[TransactionItemCreateWithPrice](#schematransactionitemcreatewithprice)|false|none|Add a non-catalog price for an existing product in your catalog to a transaction. In this case, the product you're billing for is a catalog product, but you charge a specific price for it.|
|*oneOf*|[TransactionItemCreateWithPriceAndProduct](#schematransactionitemcreatewithpriceandproduct)|false|none|Add a non-catalog price for a non-catalog product in your catalog to a transaction. In this case, the product and price that you're billing for are specific to this transaction.|

Represents a transaction entity when updating transactions.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|object|false|read-only|none|
|status|object|false|none|Status of this transaction. You may set a transaction to `billed` or `canceled`. Billed transactions cannot be updated, only canceled.<br><br>For manually-collected transactions, marking as `billed` is essentially issuing an invoice.<br><br>You can cancel transactions that are `draft`, `ready`, `billed`, or `past_due`, except transactions that Paddle created for a subscription and automatically-collected transactions that are `past_due`.|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the customer that this transaction is for, prefixed with `ctm_`.|
|address_id|[AddressId](#schemaaddressid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the address that this transaction is for, prefixed with `add_`.|
|business_id|[BusinessId](#schemabusinessid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the business that this transaction is for, prefixed with `biz_`.|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|false|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|currency_code|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode) \| null|false|none|Supported three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Must be `USD`, `EUR`, or `GBP` if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|origin|[PublicTransactionOrigin](#schemapublictransactionorigin)|false|none|none|
|subscription_id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the subscription that this transaction is for, prefixed with `sub_`.|
|invoice_id|string \| null|false|read-only|**Deprecated.** Paddle ID of the invoice that this transaction is related to, prefixed with `inv_`. Used for compatibility with the Paddle Invoice API, which is now deprecated. This field is scheduled to be removed in the next version of the Paddle API.|
|invoice_number|string \| null|false|read-only|Invoice number for this transaction. Automatically generated by Paddle when you mark a transaction as `billed` where `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|collection_mode|object|false|none|How payment is collected for this transaction. `automatic` for checkout, `manual` for invoices.|
|discount_id|[DiscountId](#schemadiscountid) \| null|false|none|Paddle ID of the discount to apply to this transaction, prefixed with `dsc_`. Send one of `discount_id` or `discount`.|
|discount|[DiscountCustom](#schemadiscountcustom) \| null|false|none|Apply a non-catalog discount to a transaction. Send one of `discount_id` or `discount`.|
|billing_details|[BillingDetailsUpdate](#schemabillingdetailsupdate) \| null|false|none|Details for invoicing. Required if `collection_mode` is `manual`.|
|billing_period|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod) \| null|false|none|Time period that this transaction is for. Set automatically by Paddle for subscription renewals to describe the period that charges are for.|
|items|[[TransactionItemUpdate](#schematransactionitemupdate)]|false|none|List of items on this transaction.<br><br>When making a request, each object must contain either a `price_id` or a `price` object, and a `quantity`.<br><br>Include a `price_id` to charge for an existing catalog item, or a `price` object to charge for a non-catalog item.|
|details|object|false|read-only|none|
|payments|[[TransactionPaymentAttempt](#schematransactionpaymentattempt)]|false|read-only|List of payment attempts for this transaction, including successful payments. Sorted by `created_at` in descending order, so most recent attempts are returned first.|
|checkout|[TransactionCheckoutCreate](#schematransactioncheckoutcreate) \| null|false|none|Paddle Checkout details for this transaction. You may pass a URL when creating or updating an automatically-collected transaction, or when creating or updating a manually-collected transaction where `billing_details.enable_checkout` is `true`.|
|created_at|object|false|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|false|read-only|none|
|billed_at|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp) \| null|false|read-only|RFC 3339 datetime string of when this transaction was marked as `billed`. `null` for transactions that aren't `billed` or `completed`. Set automatically by Paddle.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|origin|api|
|origin|subscription_charge|
|origin|subscription_payment_method_change|
|origin|subscription_recurring|
|origin|subscription_update|
|origin|web|

|product_id|[ProductId](#schemaproductid) \| null|true|none|Paddle ID for the product that this price is for, prefixed with `pro_`.<br>The value is null for custom products being previewed.|
|description|string|true|none|Internal description for this price, not shown to customers. Typically notes for your team.|
|type|object|true|none|none|
|name|[PriceName](#schemapricename) \| null|true|none|none|
|billing_cycle|[Duration](#schemaduration) \| null|true|none|How often this price should be charged. `null` if price is non-recurring (one-time).|
|trial_period|[PriceTrialDuration](#schemapricetrialduration) \| null|true|none|Trial period for the product related to this price. The billing cycle begins once the trial period is over. `null` for no trial period. Requires `billing_cycle`.|
|tax_mode|object|true|none|none|
|unit_price|object|true|none|Base price. This price applies to all customers, except for customers located in countries where you have `unit_price_overrides`.|
|unit_price_overrides|[[UnitPriceOverride](#schemaunitpriceoverride)]|true|none|List of unit price overrides. Use to override the base price with a custom price and currency for a country or group of countries.|
|quantity|object|true|none|Limits on how many times the related product can be purchased at this price. Useful for discount campaigns.|
|status|object|true|none|none|
|custom_data|[CustomData](#schemacustomdata) \| null|true|none|Your own structured key-value data.|
|import_meta|[ImportMeta](#schemaimportmeta) \| null|true|none|Import information for this entity. `null` if this entity is not imported.|
|created_at|object|true|read-only|none|
|updated_at|object|true|read-only|none|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
